reason: Create the skin and vessel breach first, so the clotting response has a clear site.
expectation: I expect a cut with a bleeding vessel, though the exact result is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: Making a clotting material also seems useful, but I prefer to establish the injury first.

effect: The cut and narrowed bleeding vessel establish the injury site; platelets can now act there.
reaction: The vessel narrowing is a useful detail, though it is not explained yet.
reason: Use platelets at the cut to begin plugging the damaged vessel.
expectation: I expect platelets to gather at the injury and form an initial plug, possibly needing reinforcement.

alternatives.reason: Clotting factors and fibrinogen likely provide reinforcement, but the platelet response seems a useful first step.

effect: The platelet plug slows the leak, but the bleeding goal remains open.
reaction: The explanation makes the platelets’ gathering clear.
reason: Combine fibrinogen with the activated clotting factors; it is the only offered gameplay action and may reinforce the plug.
expectation: I expect the factors to convert fibrinogen into fibrin that can help stabilize the plug.

effect: Fibrin threads are available to reinforce the platelet plug.
reaction: The mesh fits the expected clotting role, although its formation is not explained.
reason: Add the threads to the plug; this is the only offered gameplay action and should help stop the bleeding.
expectation: I expect a fibrin-reinforced clot that stops the leak.

effect: The fibrin mesh reinforced the platelet plug and stopped the bleeding, while the skin remains open.
reaction: The distinction between sealing the vessel and closing the skin is satisfying and clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding fibrin to the platelet plug was most worthwhile: the planned picture and explanation show how the plug is reinforced without suggesting the skin has already healed.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making fibrin threads was less informative than it could have been: the result shows a mesh but does not explain how the activated factors convert fibrinogen into fibrin.

surprise.text: The cut vessel was already narrowed, but the result did not explain why; that detail prompted curiosity.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though creating fibrin separately from the body felt somewhat abstract because its formation was not explained.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested to see how the still-open skin repairs itself after bleeding stops, although this chapter's choices were mostly straightforward.
